'''Serious Training on Iron Island!!''' (Japanese: '''こうてつじまで本格修業!!''' ''Serious Training at Steel Island!!'') is the 10th chapter of the [[Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* Hareta travels to [[Iron Island]] where he sees [[B-2]].
* Hareta meets [[Riley]] and his {{TP|Riley|Lucario}}, who defeat the Grunt.
* Riley gives Hareta a Pokémon {{pkmn|Egg}} which hatches into a Riolu.
* Hareta catches an Onix, Geodude, and Zubat.
* B-2 battles Hareta and Riley.
* Hareta's Shinx evolves into Luxio.
* Hareta meets up with Byron again for a rematch.
